originalAlarm.description: The value written to `&argc` is never used.

reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: 061fd0a353e.c (BusyBox hdparm). Dead store on 'argc' at line 16 (the comma expression 'p = *argv++, --argc') with UNREGISTER_HWIF=true, SCAN_HWIF=false. argc is decremented in case 'W' but never read afterwards — simplification artifact (real hdparm uses argc in further option processing). With UNREGISTER_HWIF=true and SCAN_HWIF=false, the real bug (UndefinedSymbol: goto expected_hwif_error in case 'U' but label defined only inside #ifdef SCAN_HWIF) applies, but the tool reports the dead store on argc instead.
